# Native WinMM mixer fixture

This repository-owned C program uses the MinGW WinMM headers and import library.
It checks native PE32 ANSI/Unicode mixer structure layouts, line/control queries,
volume and mute, multimedia clock queries and balanced timer-period requests.
It plays a supplied PCM WAV twice; the probe checks exact volume-scaled and muted
samples at the runtime's PCM driver boundary. Exit zero indicates success; a
failure exits with the C source line number.

Rebuild with `npm run build:winmm` using MinGW i686. `npm test` executes it in
Node; `npm run test:winmm` executes it in an isolated Chromium worker and writes
`evidence/winmm-browser-results.json`. The WAV is generated by
`scripts/lib/winmm-probe.js`. No physical speaker, capture, callback timer or
general Windows audio compatibility is claimed by this fixture.
